at_a_glance.detail: Management raised its full-year 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to a range of $11.05 to $11.25 and increased its full-year revenue expectations to between $11.95 billion and $12.05 billion.

at_a_glance.headline: Stock Rallies to New Highs
at_a_glance.detail: Following the strong operational beat and raised outlook, Quest Diagnostics shares jumped more than 8% to hit a fresh 52-week high.

at_a_glance.headline: Operational Efficiencies Buffer Cost Headwinds
at_a_glance.detail: The company expanded its utilization of automation and AI in lab operations to drive productivity, which helped counteract lower revenue per requisition and upcoming spending on Project Nova.

LH.summary: Labcorp delivered a strong Q2 2026, with enterprise revenue growing 6% (5.8% adjusted) to $3.7B, driven by 4.2% organic growth. Adjusted EPS increased 15% to $4.99, beating expectations. Adjusted operating margins expanded 70 basis points to 15.8%, marking the fifth consecutive quarter of enterprise and segment margin expansion.

key_moments.title: Specialty Testing Outperformance
key_moments.blurb: Priority specialty areas like oncology and neurology posted double-digit revenue growth. These high-margin tests drive multi-test accessions, meaning oncology patients yield greater testing frequency over time, lifting Diagnostics price-mix metrics above routine baseline growth.

key_moments.title: Early Development Turnaround and Margin Growth
key_moments.blurb: Restructuring actions in Early Development are largely complete, driving a 130 basis point expansion in BLS operating margins. Management upgraded full-year Early Development revenue expectations to low single-digit growth, indicating improving market dynamics and on-time study starts.

key_moments.title: Full-Year Guidance Hike
key_moments.blurb: Labcorp raised its full-year 2026 enterprise revenue growth range to 5.4%-6.3% and boosted its adjusted EPS midpoint by $0.30 to a range of $18.10-$18.55, reflecting strong operational performance, solid volume growth, and completed strategic restructurings.

key_moments.title: Payer Mix and ACA Updates
key_moments.blurb: Management confirmed that a 20-30 basis point headwind from ACA/Medicaid shifts occurred in Q2, aligning with their expected full-year Diagnostics segment impact of 30 basis points. Bad debt remains steady at roughly 5% of revenue, tracking in line with historical levels.

at_a_glance.headline: Labcorp Tops Estimated Financial Targets
at_a_glance.detail: Labcorp reported a quarterly revenue of $3.731 billion, surpassing expectations of $3.714 billion, while reported adjusted EPS reached $3.64.

at_a_glance.headline: Strong Segment Growth and Margins
at_a_glance.detail: The Biopharma Laboratory Services segment grew 6.5% to $836 million with a strong 1.14 book-to-bill ratio, while Diagnostics grew 5.5% to $2.9 billion, expanding overall adjusted operating margins by 70 basis points to 15.8%.

at_a_glance.headline: Full Year 2026 Guidance Upgraded
at_a_glance.detail: Management raised its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to a range of $18.10 to $18.55 and bumped enterprise revenue growth projections to between 5.4% and 6.3%.

at_a_glance.headline: Expanded Share Repurchase Program Authorized
at_a_glance.detail: The Board of Directors approved a $1.0 billion increase in Labcorp's share buyback capacity, increasing the company's remaining repurchase authorization to $1.4 billion.

at_a_glance.headline: Oncology Portfolio and Testing Innovation
at_a_glance.detail: The company advanced its Oncology offerings across lung, colorectal, and prostate cancers, while also expanding its direct-to-consumer footprint via the launch of a new genetic health panel called Marker by Labcorp.

CERT.summary: Certara reported Q2 2026 total revenue of $93.3 million, up 1% year-over-year, which missed the estimated $98.1 million. Total bookings grew 1% to $98.3 million. Software revenue grew 4% to $48.8 million, driven by Simcyp, Phoenix, and Pinnacle 21, while services revenue declined 3% to $44.5 million.

key_moments.title: Revenue and EPS Miss Estimates
key_moments.blurb: Certara's reported Q2 2026 revenue of $93.3M and adjusted EPS of $0.08 both fell short of consensus estimates, signaling sluggish top- and bottom-line momentum due to a 3% decline in services revenue and stranded costs following the divestiture of its regulatory business.

key_moments.title: Margin Guidance Revised Lower Due to Divestiture
key_moments.blurb: Management lowered its full-year adjusted EBITDA margin guidance range to 29%-31% from 30%-32%. Investors will note that this adjustment is driven by unallocated overhead infrastructure that remained with the company after selling the Regulatory and Medical Writing business, rather than underlying core operational deterioration.

key_moments.title: Expanded Cost Savings Plan via RIF
key_moments.blurb: To address stranded corporate overhead and fund innovative AI capabilities, Certara executed a 5% reduction in force. This elevated run-rate savings to $13 million, replacing a prior $10 million cost plan, which will please investors looking for active margin protection into 2027.

key_moments.title: Go-To-Market Pivot Rejuvenating Services Pipeline
key_moments.blurb: CEO Jon Resnick highlighted a major strategic shift away from a generalist sales model toward a specialist, PhD-led scientific engagement approach. This reversal has successfully accelerated the services pipeline by 27% year-over-year, which management expects will convert to revenue growth in the second half of 2026.

at_a_glance.headline: Certara Misses Top and Bottom Lines
at_a_glance.detail: Certara reported a Q2 2026 adjusted EPS of -$0.36, heavily missing the estimated $0.091, while its quarterly revenue of $93.27 million fell short of the estimated $98.08 million.

at_a_glance.headline: Software Strength Partially Offsets Services Strain
at_a_glance.detail: Software revenue grew 4% year-over-year to $48.8 million, now representing 53% of total business, whereas services revenue declined 3% to $44.5 million following the divestiture of its regulatory and medical writing business.

at_a_glance.headline: Full-Year Margins and Guidance Trimmed
at_a_glance.detail: Management trimmed its full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to a range of 29% to 31% from its previous 30% to 32% projection to reflect the impact of the divestiture.

at_a_glance.headline: AI Innovation Bolstered by NVIDIA Partnership
at_a_glance.detail: Certara announced a new partnership with NVIDIA to integrate the BioNeMo Agent Toolkit into its biosimulation and regulatory platforms, aiming to enhance product development and client engagement.

at_a_glance.headline: Leadership Reshuffled to Boost Commercial Execution
at_a_glance.detail: The company underwent an executive shake-up, appointing Julien Perrier as Chief Commercial Officer to drive a new specialist-led commercial model amid its ongoing business transformation.

at_a_glance.headline: Stock Plunges Premarket and Share Buybacks Expand
at_a_glance.detail: The disappointing results sent shares sliding by over 16% in early trading, though management approved a fresh $50 million share repurchase program to signal long-term structural confidence.
